summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle
details: The `preinstall` script in this package downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a 727KB obfuscated sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. Both the `setup.mjs` dropper and the `math_init.js` payload use obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and rotated string-array indirection (`_0xNNNNNN` names, `WV8StW` array-shuffle deobfuscator), so the code that actually runs on the installer's machine is not human-readable. The package advertises itself as a design-token library, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque compiled bundle at install time. Fetching an alien runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle at `npm install` is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the payload sidesteps analysis of Node-resolved code and gains arbitrary execution on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
